learner_words: I told Pip you have to slide the sounds together not just say them next to each other.
guide_note: Wednesday. Jo finished the Word Chain Race session before I had even finished making tea. Got 11 of 14 and hit level 2. The two blend reversals are worth noting — Jo does not always slow down enough on the short blends and rushes the order. After finishing, Jo spontaneously helped Pip with the same issue, which was good to see. I did not ask Jo to do that. Jo explained it clearly and invented a little gesture for it. I will mention the blend-order thing again next week as a gentle focus point, since it showed up for both kids.
